thread:
Alex M: Quick sync: should compression be done at SDK, collector, or both? Thoughts on cost attribution and sampling.

Priya S: SDK compress saves customer bandwidth but prevents attribute inspection unless we keep indexable metadata outside the blob.

Marco: Collectors decompressing everything is expensive. Prefer hdr/body split so routing/tagging uses hdr only.

Li Chen: Chunking note: large compressed batches hurt partial-recovery. Recommend max-envelope-size + chunked upload.

Alex M: Proposal: require small plaintext hdr with tenant/billing and sampling-index, compress body. Collector does lazy decompress.

Priya S: That needs SDK schema bump and migration guide. I'll draft RFC.

Marco: I'll bench gzip/zstd/brotli on our collector types and post numbers here.

infra-bot: collector v2.4.0 in staging accepts Content-Encoding and exposes decompress metrics.

Li Chen: Also add metrics: decompress_count, decompress_cpu_ms, envelope_size_hist. Failures should mark body-unavailable but keep hdr for billing.

Alex M: Action items: RFC (Priya), perf runs (Marco), chunking spec (Li), SDK guidance (Alex). Keep SDK compression opt-in for rollout.

Priya S: I'll push RFC draft in 48h.

Marco: +1

Alex M: Thanks everyone.
